details: VELDO-0077 detail: satisfaction/stale-evidence: an assessment over it is refused as stale evidence by name; the objective is not satisfied

VELDO-0077 detail: satisfaction/unproven-outcome: the objective is accepted and every one of its specifications is shipped; the assessment is refused as an unproven outcome; the objective is not satisfied
VELDO-0077 detail: satisfaction/other-process: it sees the shipped-but-unproven objective still ACTIVE

VELDO-0077 detail: cancel/transfer-bounded: a transfer outside the receiver's accepted scope is refused by name; nothing was written for it; a disposition set naming one feature twice is refused; nothing was written for that either; an in-scope transfer moves the feature under the receiver's accepted revision

VELDO-0077 detail: project/inactive-refusals: while paused: amend, accept, propose_feature and assess are refused by name; nothing was written while paused; canceled proj-a: amend, propose_feature and assess are refused by name, nothing written; completed proj-b: amend, accept and a new objective are refused by name, nothing written
